line_items.work_text: Ex-post facto approval for Rs. 41,15,200/- sanctioned by the Deputy Commissioner Barpeta as financial assistance to 28 damaged AWCs of Barpeta district during 2021.
Ex-post facto approval for Rs. 1,25,05,501/- sanctioned by the Deputy Commissioner, Darrang to 4097 beneficiaries as financial assistance related to Crop damage due to flood during 2021.

narrative: SEC noted the matters discussed and stated that the Deputy Commissioners are authorised to sanction these assistance at their end which do not require further approval of SEC.
